text:
maria: Pushing a config-only change now — routing weights + batching tweak. batch_window_ms=40, request_timeout_s=5. No model updates. Deploying a thin-slice during the midday change window.
deploy-bot: [deploy started] cfg-only /env=prod label=thin-edge-2412 canary=3% initiator=maria
aj: Quick question — what's the fallback plan if latency or errors jump? :eyes:
paige: Fallback is automatic routing fallback to `fallback-pool-v1` + revert batching param for affected pool. Manual rollback plan: pin routing weights back and disable the batch_window tweak.
liam: Observability checklist: enable per-route p50/p95/p99, error-rate, tokens/sec, and synthetic ping every 30s. I'll watch dashboards.
maria: Config snippet:
```json
{"batch_window_ms":40, "request_timeout_s":5, "routing_policy":"fairness_v2", "canary_percent":3}
```
aj: LGTM for canary. Proposal: 3% for 10m, then 10% for 15m, then 100% if stable.
paige: I'll be on watch. Trigger conditions to rollback: p95 increase >20% absolute or error-rate +0.5% sustained for 5m, or regional p99 spikes with request timeout errors.
monitor-bot: [metric update @ t+3m] canary p95 +4% (baseline 120ms -> 125ms), errors +0.02%. No alerts.
deploy-bot: Canary advanced to 10% (automated step)
liam: Saw a brief spike in EU-1 at t+6m — small sample. Investigating whether it's correlated with batch_window reduction.
paige: I just rolled back batching change for EU-1 only (reverted batch_window_ms -> 80). Routing weight tweak still in place. Noticed a drop in p95 immediately.
maria: Confirming: rollout continues for the rest of the fleet, only EU-1 batching param reverted, correct?
paige: Correct. Continuing canary at 10% elsewhere. Will escalate if other pools follow the same pattern.
aj: Keep it paused at 10% until we hit 30m stable. Also, note in release notes: config-only — routing fairness adjustments and reduced batch window (partial regional revert applied). No model or runtime binary changes.
maria: Copy. I'll prepare the release note and changelog entry and mark this as config-only with the partial rollback annotation. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
